steps.name: Write audit summary
steps.run:
echo "## 🔍 ${{ inputs.domain }} Validator — Audit Log" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| Gate | Result |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "|------|--------|" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| Lint | ${{ needs.lint.result }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| TypeScript | ${{ needs.typecheck.result }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| Tests | ${{ needs.tests.result }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| Security | ${{ needs.security.result }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "**KPI targets:** eval ≤ ${{ inputs.perf_eval_ms }}ms · API ≤ ${{ inputs.perf_api_ms }}ms" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "Agent: \`${{ github.actor }}\` · Run: [\`${{ github.run_id }}\`](${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}) · $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

# Fail if any gate failed
if [ "${{ needs.lint.result }}" != "success" ] || \
   [ "${{ needs.typecheck.result }}" != "success" ] || \
   [ "${{ needs.tests.result }}" != "success" ] || \
   [ "${{ needs.security.result }}" != "success" ]; then
  echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  echo "❌ **${{ inputs.domain }} validation FAILED**" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  exit 1
fi
echo "✅ **${{ inputs.domain }} validation PASSED**" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

domain.description: Human-readable domain name shown in job titles

lint_paths.description: Space-separated list of paths/files to pass to eslint

test_commands.description: Newline-separated shell commands that run the test suite

scan_paths.description: Space-separated paths to scan for secrets

label.description: GitHub label to add/assert on the PR (e.g. gigatron)

perf_api_ms.description: API response KPI in milliseconds (informational, shown in summary)

perf_eval_ms.description: Engine evaluation KPI in milliseconds (informational, shown in summary)

steps.name: Run Engine Registry Check
steps.run:
echo "## 🔌 Engine Registry Report" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

# Count registered engines in engine-registry-all.ts
REGISTERED=$(grep -c "^import './engines/" src/lib/engine-registry-all.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
echo "📦 **Registrovanih engine-a u barrel fajlu:** $REGISTERED" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

# Find all engine wrapper files in src/lib/engines/
WRAPPER_FILES=$(find src/lib/engines -name "*.ts" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
echo "🗂️ **Engine wrapper fajlova u src/lib/engines/:** $WRAPPER_FILES" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

# Find engine wrapper files NOT imported in engine-registry-all.ts
UNCONNECTED=0
UNCONNECTED_LIST=""
while IFS= read -r file; do
  BASENAME=$(basename "$file" .ts)
  if ! grep -q "engines/${BASENAME}" src/lib/engine-registry-all.ts 2>/dev/null; then
    UNCONNECTED=$((UNCONNECTED + 1))
    UNCONNECTED_LIST="$UNCONNECTED_LIST\n- \`src/lib/engines/${BASENAME}.ts\`"
  fi
done < <(find src/lib/engines -name "*.ts" 2>/dev/null)

if [ "$UNCONNECTED" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "### ⚠️ Nepovezani Engine Wrapper-i ($UNCONNECTED)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
  echo "Sledeći engine wrapper fajlovi nisu uvezeni u \`engine-registry-all.ts\`:" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
  printf "%b" "$UNCONNECTED_LIST" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
  echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
  echo "UNCONNECTED_COUNT=$UNCONNECTED" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
else
  echo "### ✅ Svi engine wrapper-i su registrovani" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
  echo "UNCONNECTED_COUNT=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
fi

# Find new lib files added in this PR that contain "Engine" export
# and are NOT in the engines/ folder and NOT in engine-registry-all.ts

DOMAIN_REGEX='^([A-Za-z0-9]|[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])(\.([A-Za-z0-9]|[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9]))+$'

if [ "$CANONICAL_DOMAIN" != "$EXPECTED_CANONICAL" ] || [ "$WILDCARD_DOMAIN" != "$EXPECTED_WILDCARD" ]; then
  echo "❌ START deploy podržava isključivo kanonski domain pair:"
  echo "   canonical_domain=$EXPECTED_CANONICAL"
  echo "   wildcard_domain=$EXPECTED_WILDCARD"
  echo "   Dobijeno: canonical_domain=$CANONICAL_DOMAIN, wildcard_domain=$WILDCARD_DOMAIN"
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "$CANONICAL_DOMAIN" == *"*"* ]]; then
  echo "❌ canonical_domain ne sme sadržati '*' (primer pogrešnog formata: spaja.nivo*spaja)."
  exit 1
fi
if [[ "$CANONICAL_DOMAIN" == .* || "$CANONICAL_DOMAIN" == *. || "$CANONICAL_DOMAIN" == *..* ]]; then
  echo "❌ canonical_domain ne sme imati prazne label-e niti vodeću/završnu tačku."
  exit 1
fi
if ! [[ "$CANONICAL_DOMAIN" =~ $DOMAIN_REGEX ]]; then
  echo "❌ canonical_domain mora biti validan apex domen (min 2 label-e)."
  exit 1
fi

if ! [[ "$WILDCARD_DOMAIN" =~ ^\*\.([A-Za-z0-9]|[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])(\.([A-Za-z0-9]|[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9]))+$ ]]; then
  echo "❌ wildcard_domain mora biti u formatu '*.domen'."
  exit 1
fi

WILDCARD_SUFFIX="${WILDCARD_DOMAIN#*.}"
if [[ "$WILDCARD_SUFFIX" == *"*"* ]]; then
  echo "❌ wildcard_domain ne sme imati '*' u sredini label-e."
  exit 1
fi
if [[ "$WILDCARD_SUFFIX" == .* || "$WILDCARD_SUFFIX" == *. || "$WILDCARD_SUFFIX" == *..* ]]; then
  echo "❌ wildcard_domain suffix ne sme imati prazne label-e niti vodeću/završnu tačku."
  exit 1
fi
if ! [[ "$WILDCARD_SUFFIX" =~ $DOMAIN_REGEX ]]; then
  echo "❌ wildcard_domain suffix mora biti validan domen."
  exit 1
fi

if [ "$WILDCARD_SUFFIX" != "$CANONICAL_DOMAIN" ]; then
  echo "❌ wildcard_domain mora mapirati isti apex domen kao canonical_domain."
  echo "   canonical_domain=$CANONICAL_DOMAIN"
  echo "   wildcard_domain=$WILDCARD_DOMAIN"
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Domen strategija validna: $CANONICAL_DOMAIN + $WILDCARD_DOMAIN"
echo "## 🌐 Domain strategy gate" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "- canonical_domain: \`$CANONICAL_DOMAIN\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "- wildcard_domain: \`$WILDCARD_DOMAIN\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

echo "- TLS policy: Vercel managed certificate za apex + wildcard" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: 🔍 Scan tracked files for likely secrets
steps.run:
python <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

repo = Path('.')
tracked = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files'], text=True).splitlines()
patterns = {
    'github_pat': re.compile(r'github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}'),
    'github_token': re.compile(r'gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}'),
    'stripe_live': re.compile(r'sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}'),
    'stripe_test': re.compile(r'sk_test_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}'),
    'stripe_webhook': re.compile(r'whsec_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}'),
    'aws_key': re.compile(r'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}'),
    'slack_token': re.compile(r'xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}'),
    'google_api_key': re.compile(r'AIza[0-9A-Za-z\-_]{35}'),
    'private_key': re.compile(r'-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH |DSA |PGP )?PRIVATE KEY-----'),
}
ignored_suffixes = {'.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.webp', '.ico', '.pdf', '.lock', '.svg'}
hits = []
for relative in tracked:
    path = repo / relative
    if path.suffix.lower() in ignored_suffixes:
        continue
    try:
        text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    except Exception:
        continue
    for name, pattern in patterns.items():
        for match in pattern.finditer(text):
            line = text.count('\n', 0, match.start()) + 1
            hits.append(f'{relative}:{line}:{name}')
if hits:
    print('Potential secrets detected:')
    for hit in hits:
        print(hit)
    sys.exit(1)
print('No likely secrets detected in tracked files.')
PY

  RESPONSE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/vercel_response.json -w "%{http_code}" \
    -X POST "$VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_AI_IQ" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json")
  
  if [ "$RESPONSE" -ge 200 ] && [ "$RESPONSE" -lt 300 ]; then
    echo "✅ Deploy hook uspešno pokrenut (HTTP $RESPONSE)"
    cat /tmp/vercel_response.json
  else
    echo "❌ Deploy hook greška (HTTP $RESPONSE)"
    cat /tmp/vercel_response.json
    exit 1
  fi
fi

echo "🔎 Provera health URL: ${{ github.event.inputs.verify_url }}"
HTTP_CODE=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/vercel_health_response.txt -w "%{http_code}" "${{ github.event.inputs.verify_url }}")
if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 200 ] && [ "$HTTP_CODE" -lt 400 ]; then
  echo "✅ Health check OK (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
  echo "status=ok" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "❌ Health check failed (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
  cat /tmp/vercel_health_response.txt || true
  echo "status=failed" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 1
fi

echo "⚠️ Deploy neuspešan, pokušavam rollback hook..."
ROLLBACK_CODE=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/vercel_rollback_response.json -w "%{http_code}" -X POST "${{ github.event.inputs.rollback_hook_url }}")
echo "Rollback HTTP: $ROLLBACK_CODE"
cat /tmp/vercel_rollback_response.json || true

echo "## ▲ Vercel Deploy — Audit Log" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| Polje | Vrednost |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "|-------|---------|" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| **Branch** | \`${{ github.ref_name }}\` |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| **Commit** | \`${{ github.sha }}\` |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| **Autor** | ${{ github.actor }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| **Environment** | ${{ github.event.inputs.environment }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| **Run ID / Attempt** | ${{ github.run_id }} / ${{ github.run_attempt }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| **Vreme** | $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "| **Pokretanje** | ${{ github.event_name }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
  echo "| **Razlog** | ${{ github.event.inputs.razlog }} |" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
